criteria.no: The required method is absent or the item specifies only a different method. Silence is no.
criteria.unclear: The item discusses dependency simulation or isolation but leaves the required fake bd/no bd/no Dolt arrangement unresolved.
criteria.yes: The item expressly carries deterministic fake bd and unit-test operation without real bd or Dolt, in equivalent wording; a separate integration check does not erase this statement.

addressed.instructions: Read the item for an explicit commitment to the full unit-test obligation from anchor.statement. Does it state fake bd is deterministic and unit tests need no bd or Dolt, directly or equivalently? Mere topic mention leaves this unclear; complete silence is no.

criteria.no: There is no conflicting unit-test requirement. Silence and separate optional non-unit integration checks are not conflicts.
criteria.unclear: It is ambiguous whether a stated dependency is required for the unit tests.
criteria.yes: The item requires real bd or Dolt for a scoped unit test, or replaces deterministic fake bd with an incompatible method.

contradicted.instructions: Read only for an incompatible requirement: do scoped unit tests need real bd, need Dolt, or abandon the deterministic fake bd? The constraint concerns unit tests, so evaluate separately identified manual integration work within that boundary.

criteria.no: The work is unrelated to those tests. Whether tests comply is irrelevant to overlap.
criteria.unclear: The item is too vague to determine whether it touches the scoped tests.
criteria.yes: The item adds, changes, or constrains unit tests for the sync job, hooks, ingest or CLI.

relevant.instructions: Would completing this item affect the unit-test work described by anchor.scope and the NFR-BDC-0005 statement? Read its specific activity, then decide only overlap.
